title: Chapter 160 Are You Going To Run Away?
content:
Chapter 160 Are You Going To Run Away?

At this time, the walls of the imperial capital of the Divine Dynasty were filled with densely packed powerful Divine Dynasty.

Everyone looked at the direction of the void in the distance with a serious expression.

The suffocating aura is getting closer and closer.

"With this little person you are now, even if you add me, you can't deal with them."

Next to Lu Xue, the man spoke.

The entire Divine Dynasty is now the strongest in his place, so he is the only one who is most qualified to say this.

Not long ago, he was still being detained by the Divine Dynasty.

This is ironic.

So, he wanted to know how this empress's daughter would solve it.

He glanced at the man lightly, and Lu Xue whispered: "With our strength, we really can't deal with them, so the best way is to hold on and wait until my mother and the others come back."

"I believe my mother and the others have realized this."

Hearing Lu Xue's answer, the man turned his head and looked at the direction of the void.

"Let's talk about other methods."

With the strength left in the imperial capital now, it is almost a fantasy to want to fight against the Spirit-Devouring Army that emerged from somewhere.

"I have two more ways, and the easiest way."

"Two? The easiest??"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, the man was obviously a little surprised.

Lu Xue nodded.

"We all directly transfer our positions to the deserted city."

As soon as these words came out, Ao Qing, who was standing by, suddenly looked lit up, "My master, this method is good. If you go to Huangcheng, no matter what kind of clan he is, it will not work."

Mr. Zhou didn't say anything and remained silent.

The man frowned even deeper.

"What's the deserted city you're talking about?"

He had never heard of the deserted city.

Hearing this, Lu Xue smiled slightly, "That's my father's power."

"Your father, is your father better than your mother?"

"Why do you have so many questions?!"

Seeing the man asking this and that, Lu Xue immediately said.

Seeing that Lu Xue was a little angry, the man shook his head helplessly.

"Then tell me the last solution."

"The last solution is to just ask my dad to come back."

"None?"

"It's gone."

At this moment, the man was stunned.

After pondering for a moment, the man glanced at Lu Xue deeply and said nothing in the end.

This guy is so amazing.

My mother is so terrifying, she actually has a mysterious father.

Looking at Lu Xue's confident face, for some reason, the man suddenly stopped nervous.

"Then what should we do next?"

At this time, Mr. Zhou and others also looked at Lu Xue.

Next, no matter what Lu Xue said, they would obey.

Looking at everyone's hopeful gaze, Lu Xue's expression also dimmed.

At this moment, a sense of responsibility suddenly arose.

"Go to the deserted city."

In the end, Lu Xue chose to run away.

After returning to the deserted city, everything is fine.

To be honest, the sense of security here is not as good as that in the deserted city.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, everyone did not hesitate and began to act.

Although it was a bit embarrassing to run away, His Royal Highness the Princess spoke, what else could they say?

It has to be said that everyone's speed is really fast. In less than a moment, the entire Divine Dynasty emperor was empty.

Lu Xue even took out the space magic weapon and stuffed everyone in it.

In this way, the entire Divine Dynasty Emperor became an empty city.

"My master, it's over."

In the void, Ao Qing transformed back into his original body. A five-clawed divine dragon, which was thousands of feet long, emitted divine light all over his body, which was very imposing!

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded and then threw the space magic weapon directly to Ao Qing.

"Take them back to the deserted city and I will stay and cut off the rear."

As soon as these words were said, Ao Qing was suddenly a little unbelievable.

"My master, what did you say!?"

"I'm cutting off the rear, how can I do if no one cuts off the rear?"

"No, little master, if something happens to you, the master will wipe me out!"

Hearing this, Lu Xue rolled her eyes.

"Listen to me, go away!"

Obviously Lu Xue has her own ideas.

And at this time, Ao Qing was about to say something.

A golden light flashed in the magic weapon in the space.

Everyone suddenly appeared in front of them.

"Your Highness, we are willing to fight with you!"

"Yes, Your Highness Princess, you don't need to sacrifice for us."

"It's just some small alien races, how can my Divine Dynasty share it!"

Everyone was passionate, and they were determined to fight the Spirit-Devouring Clan's life and death.

Looking at everyone, Lu Xue's mouth twitched slightly.

She really wanted to say, you know nothing, from beginning to end, she had never been afraid of this Spirit-Devouring Clan.

Who is she? She is Lu Daosheng's daughter.

"well."

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly sighed heavily.

Seeing this, everyone asked quickly, "Your Highness, why are you sighing?"

But Lu Xue said sadly, "I originally wanted to get along with you as an ordinary person."

Immediately, Lu Xue's face suddenly became angry.

"But the Spirit-Devouring Clan is really too bullying!"

"Don't pretend."

Boom!

At this moment, the void in the distance suddenly cracked.

The next moment, a huge and terrifying aura suddenly surged out from it.

In just a moment, the entire void shattered!

"Hahahaha, ants, tremble!"

I saw countless Soul Devourers suddenly rushing out from the cracks in the void.

The number was extremely huge.

It was hard to imagine that such a force actually bypassed the attention of the main force of the Divine Dynasty and rushed directly into the abdomen of the Divine Dynasty.

No wonder Yan Lingyun's face changed drastically.

The aura of the three Soul Devourers in the lead was even more terrifying.

They were actually three peak mortal realm masters.

Seeing this scene, everyone's expression suddenly sank.

There is no comparison at all.

"How is it, despair?"

Shi Jin sneered.

"Your empress is too busy to care about you now."

"When she knows that you all died tragically, I wonder what her expression will be. I'm really looking forward to it."

Suddenly, shrill laughter continued to sound from the void.

"Aren't you afraid of my mother's crazy revenge?"

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly said coldly.

Hearing this, Shi Jin and the others were stunned for a moment, and then looked at Lu Xue.

Seeing Lu Xue's face that was somewhat similar to Yan Lingyun, several people were immediately ecstatic.

"You, you are the daughter of that crazy woman!"

"Ahahaha, I didn't expect that there would be an unexpected surprise on this trip!"

Then, Shi Jin looked at Lu Xue with a lewd smile, "Girl, I will torture you well and finally devour you bit by bit."

"If you dare to touch my young master, I will fight you!"

At this time, Ao Qing suddenly roared.

Looking at Ao Qing who was filled with righteous indignation, Lu Xue's heart was slightly touched, and then she reached out to comfort Ao Qing, signaling him not to be impulsive.

"Do you think I'm afraid of you?"

Lu Xue's face was cold.

And Shi Jin was about to say something, but Shi Ren on the side shook his head slightly.

"Don't waste time anymore, don't forget our plan."

Hearing this, Shi Jin snorted lightly and said nothing more.

Shi Ren stepped forward and said, "I don't care what your confidence is, but being an enemy of my Soul Devouring Clan is doomed to end."
